about: v0.6 names of package D (same schema as names.json; ids must be new). Kathā-only: the practice game never sees them. Used by the herbs cutscene's Sanskrit (ऋषभस्य कैलासस्य च मध्ये …, Yuddha 6.74.30–31).

sources.name: Vālmīki Rāmāyaṇa, valmikiramayan.net (vulgate)
sources.note: Yuddha 6.74.30 (fetched): ततः काञ्चनमत्युग्रमृषभं पर्वतोत्तमम् — Jāmbavān: you will see the golden Ṛṣabha, best of mountains, and the peak of Kailāsa; 6.74.31 तयोः शिखरयोर्मध्ये … the herb mountain between the two peaks; 6.74.61 Hanumān sees Ṛṣabha.

sources.name: Monier-Williams, Sanskrit-English Dictionary (1899), via kosha.sanskrit.today
sources.note: s.v. ऋषभ, m.: among its senses "of a mountain" (fetched).

provenance.notes: Both sources read online this session (agent v06-D). Masculine (MW); the dialogue uses only the genitive ऋषभस्य.

sources.name: Vālmīki Rāmāyaṇa, valmikiramayan.net (vulgate)
sources.note: Yuddha 6.74.30 (fetched): कैलासशिखरं चापि द्रक्ष्यस्यरिनिषूदन; 6.74.61: कैलासमग्र्यं हिमवच्छिलां च.

sources.name: Monier-Williams, Sanskrit-English Dictionary (1899), and Apte, via kosha.sanskrit.today
sources.note: MW s.v. कैलास, m.: "N. of a mountain (fabulous residence of Kubera and paradise of Śiva"; Apte: "a peak of the Himālayas and residence of Śiva and Kubera" (fetched).

provenance.notes: All sources read online this session (agent v06-D). Masculine; the dialogue uses only the genitive कैलासस्य.
